summary: The Schedule Fatigue Tax ORtg estimate is withheld. Its cited -1.73 result measures scoring margin (no-rest minus rested), not offensive rating per 100 possessions. The historical artifact misstates both the unit and subtraction order; its ORtg-derived values cannot be interpreted as validated measurements. Schedule counts and frequencies remain descriptive. The review date is not an observation date.
evidence: corpus=player_boxscores_2024_25_2025_26; n=4732; avg margin on 0-rest (-1.41, n=856) vs >=1-day rest (0.32, n=3876)

reading: The source reports two runs; this audit identifies the 4732-observation run cited by the fatigue artifact. Their observations must not be added or treated as independent replication.
The difference of the published group means is -1.41 minus 0.32 = -1.73 scoring-margin points. No possession denominator or ORtg comparison is published in this receipt.
Neither the raw margin association nor a constant multiplied by schedule frequency establishes a causal fatigue effect or a team-specific forecast.
The historical source JSON and original image remain available as archival evidence. Their ORtg interpretation is under review; no replacement ORtg or margin tax is invented.
